bootstrap_job_name.description: Bootstrap Job resource, when separately enabled; Terraform never runs it.

restore_instance_name.description: Separate run-scoped Cloud SQL instance. Null while the gate is off.

restore_job_name.description: Single-shot pg_restore Job resource; Terraform creates it but does not execute it.

retire_job_name.description: Post-verify retirement Job resource; Terraform never runs it.

verify_job_name.description: Separate verifier Job resource; Terraform never runs it.

description.constant_value: Restrict temporary administrative connector access to the one run-scoped instance.

Restrict temporary IAM database login capability to the run-scoped restore instance.

admin_password_secret_version.description: Exact existing numeric Secret Manager version; secret payloads and versions are never Terraform-managed.

allow_restore_destroy.description: Run-bound gate that first lowers Cloud SQL and Cloud Run deletion protections.

confirm_bootstrap_complete.description: Operator acknowledgment only after bootstrap Job evidence verifies roles, extensions, and target ACLs.

confirm_destroy_run_id.description: Must exactly match run_id before a separately reviewed teardown sequence.

confirm_isolated_restore.description: Explicit acknowledgment that this root creates a separate private Cloud SQL instance and run-scoped bucket.

enable_bootstrap_job.description: Separate gate for the one-shot bootstrap Job, after the exact admin secret version and image digests are reviewed.

enable_foundation.description: Default-off gate for the separate instance, database, artifact bucket, admin identity, and secret metadata.

enable_restore_jobs.description: Separate gate for restore, verify, and retire Jobs plus IAM SQL users. Requires separately confirmed successful bootstrap.

executor_image.description: Reviewed immutable multi-phase executor image digest. No image is built or pushed by Terraform.

manifest_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact synthetic run manifest; supplied only after fixture/dump/TOC review.

migration_inventory_sha256.description: SHA-256 of immutable V1-V61 inventory, reviewed with the exact dump manifest.

proxy_image.description: Reviewed immutable Cloud SQL Auth Proxy OCI digest; mutable tags are rejected.
